value.rationale: The mathematically natural unknown refinement is the complete shape and multiplicity distribution of minimum weak two-metric landmark sets of near-square Cartesian complete graphs, not a routine restatement of their already-known scalar minimum. The three residue classes have different allowed component profiles and a bivariate exponential enumerator enabling exact huge counts; knowledge of the scalar alone cannot determine these. This is a complete infinite-family classification in a parameter range motivated by the published rectangular gap.
